What Was the Dover Demon? Bill Bartlett Recalls the 1977 Sightings

Four teenagers reported seeing a mysterious creature in Dover, Massachusetts, in 1977. Nearly 50 years later, the town is reflecting on the sightings and the legend they inspired

In April 1977, a mysterious creature was reported in the woods of Dover, Massachusetts, by four teenagers over the course of three alleged sightings.

This led to a media frenzy in this small community, bolstered by a sketch of the creature drawn by then 17-year-old Bill Bartlett. In 2026, Bartlett sat down to share his memories of this event, while cryptozoology investigator Loren Coleman gave his thoughts and recollections.

Meanwhile, the Dover Historical Society discussed ways the town (and pop culture) have grown to embrace the so-called Dover Demon.
